title: The week in film photography
summary: A quiet week for film news, with Black Friday deals filling most feeds and one new piece of home developing kit.

children.headline: Reveni Labs crowdfunds KUVO, an automated developing machine for home and small labs
children.summary: Reveni Labs, which made the earlier Dunkbot, is raising money on Kickstarter until 8 January for a rotary processor with its own pump, valve and controller. It runs black and white at room temperature and C41, E6 and ECN-2 with a heated water bath.
